macOSBuildScript.description: Universal macOS helper build for arm64 and x86_64 with lipo verification argument order corrected.

windowsBuildScript.description: Initializes the Visual Studio x64 compiler and Windows SDK environment for service-based runners, validates required headers and libraries, and cleans a disposable temporary COFF object directory.

discoveryPrivacy.description: Keeps DNS-SD URIs and raw Windows WSD device IDs inside the trusted main process; returns keyed HMAC-SHA-256 selectors with process-lifetime scope and bounded in-memory mapping, while native Windows pairing rechecks the live device state.
